$doc: FORMAT-PRUNE FP27c: engine memory CI's own per-zone readings, which zones its ledger measures and at what golden bytes. Moved here unchanged from shard-format 0.38.1 memory-armed.json zones (the @wildshard/memory-policy alias), since the format keeps no zone list (FP27c) and which zones are armed for admission is the API catalogue's word (FP27). The lines come from the pinned format (memory-armed.json lines).
